purpose: One fixed-parent cross-chain optimizer-direction diagnosis before any longer CT continuation; prior two recipe trajectories and their independent audits are retained.
folds: Two parity splits of32 independent archived audit chains:512 fit records/512 held records in each fold. Directions are frozen on fit records and evaluated conditionally on held chains; do not combine the reversed-fold errors as independent.
scope: Literal legacy sampler replay reconstructs already-known audit configurations. Four complete-H center queries check record identity. Equal tangent-FS on fit, actual finite-step FS and ESS on both fit and held. This is an energy-slope diagnosis, not an energy/variance audit of an optimized state; no new training or new Born stream.
prior_audit_decision: Adam improves1.75SE vs original parent with lower variance point estimate; SR+Adam worsens3.80SE despite similar cumulative actual FS. Diagnose conditional descent geometry, not an ansatz ceiling.
